# Pookie

> Pookie is a gentle web companion for older adults (including people living with memory loss) and the family and care teams who help them. English and Hindi. It is a companion, not a medical device: it does not diagnose, treat or change medicines. In an emergency, call the local emergency number (112 in India).

## What it does
- Daily check-ins (mood, sleep, energy, "I'd like some help"), always started by the elder.
- Medicines with explicit answers: Taken, Missed, or "Not confirmed" — never guessed.
- Doctor appointments with preparation notes, history, and "Add to my calendar" (.ics).
- Reminder history: what Pookie reminded the person about.
- LifeBook of approved memories; the AI companion only talks about approved facts and says when it doesn't know.
- Apne Log: family members see only what the elder grants, and the elder can pause sharing at any time.
- Health hub, emergency contacts, a simplified mode, and a care-team dashboard for clinics.

## Privacy
- Without Pookie's server, everything stays in the browser on the device.
- With the server, data is stored per person with role-based access rules. See /privacy.

## Pages
- [Welcome](/): start, or explore with an invented sample person (Asha).
- [Privacy](/privacy): what Pookie keeps and who sees it.

Personal screens (/home, /medications, /appointments, /health and others) hold private data and are not meant to be crawled.
